hypothesis: The eight-worker resident image, the stage-2 monitor and the 904-byte session fit the fixed reservations and enter the OS within a small instruction budget.

conditions.check: checks/stage2-session.py: loader post-load entry function with the authenticated producer session already in memory; SID, watchdog and counter registers modeled
conditions.reservation: stage-2 BSS ends at 0x47029fe0 and its stack at 0x4702dfe0, inside the existing 4 MiB reservation; fixed report at 0x47008000

narrative: The checked eight-worker image has a 2,100,336-byte initialized runtime span. The combined stage-2 monitor has 32,560 initialized bytes, leaving 208 bytes before the fixed report at 0x47008000. Its BSS ends at 0x47029fe0 and its stack at 0x4702dfe0, inside the existing 4 MiB reservation. The post-load 904-byte entry case executes 37,561 modeled instructions before OS entry; this is an instruction budget, not a measured boot time. Models: base model, zero padding to 0x44800000, overlay model, 14,949,200 bytes in all; WAV 114,924 bytes at 0x45000000.

hypothesis: The resident OS boots cold from a preserved, explicitly allocated microSD card and runs the recorded recognition without a host.
prediction: Static budgets: four slot extents, one flat-runtime pass, one bounded model-copy pass, no host activity during recognition startup. The task mask is computed once from the sealed session; each supervision pass adds one bit test per service; service progress reporting remains one atomic store. Runtime cost remains the slot hash/copy and input authentication, plus one 16-byte SID digest and constant-size session stamping. The SD owner replaces identification-speed loading through the existing post-DRAM SD core. Physical boot completion requires the whole path to run from a preserved card with a reserved allocation, backup-first installation, successful autonomous recognition, service timing and normal watchdog reboot.
conclusion: Not run: cold boot latency is unmeasured, no production card reservation or backup exists, and the card producer is not implemented.
narrative: Physical completion also needs the native loader to stop refusing unproven remote writers and CPU/cache ownership before SD access. The monitor package and boot0 remain separately protected storage ranges, not atomic with a slot header; a physical installation retains recovery for interruption of those writes and establishes monitor/session compatibility before treating the new slot as a working fallback. Optional DRAM restore keeps its own temperature and memory qualification; the default bundle uses the pinned full-training boot0.
